evidence_quotes.quote: se le asigna un valor de 1 si la característica se cumple casi en su totalidad, de 0.5 si se
comparativos por pares no permiten generalizar los resultados hacia la población.

publication_year_note: Both the journal volume header ('FRONTERA NORTE VOL. 32, ART. 2, 2020') and the online publication date ('Publicación en web: 6 de febrero de 2020') are in 2020 (received October 9, 2018; accepted March 25, 2019).
rationale: This is a comparative two-city case study (N = 2 utilities: Aguas de Saltillo and Agua de Hermosillo, 2001-2015) that scores 17 institutional-capacity indicators on an ordinal 0 / 0.5 / 1 rubric (averaging 0.88 in Saltillo vs. 0.28 in Hermosillo, Table 2) and contrasts them descriptively against utility performance time series (coverage, continuous supply share, physical/commercial efficiency, operating profit) and secondary INEGI survey percentages. No inferential statistical tests, regressions, correlations, standard errors, confidence intervals, test statistics, or p-values are reported anywhere in the paper.
